articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly analyze video feeds, codebases, and audio streams in a single inference pass. The model demonstrates significant improvements on agentic coding benchmarks like SWE-bench Verified, scoring over 75%, and introduces a new long-context architecture supporting 1M+ token windows with minimal degradation. This positions it as a serious contender for enterprise-grade autonomous software engineering workflows.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Graduate-Level Science Benchmarks
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which surpasses previous frontier models on GPQA Diamond and a new suite of graduate-level scientific reasoning tasks spanning physics, chemistry, and biology. The model leverages a novel mixture-of-experts architecture with over 2 trillion parameters and demonstrates emergent chain-of-thought capabilities in formal mathematical proofs. Google is integrating it across Workspace and Cloud Vertex AI with sub-second latency for most queries.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Deploys Humanoid Workers at BMW's Spartanburg Plant at Scale
articles.summary: Figure AI announced the deployment of over 200 of its Figure 03 humanoid robots at BMW's Spartanburg, South Carolina manufacturing facility, marking the largest commercial humanoid deployment in automotive history. The robots handle bin picking, parts transfer, and quality inspection tasks with a reported 99.2% reliability rate across 16-hour shifts. The deployment uses on-device vision-language models fine-tuned for factory-floor object recognition and manipulation.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics Atlas Now Performs Autonomous Disaster Search-and-Rescue in DARPA Trials
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics showcased the latest electric Atlas performing fully autonomous search-and-rescue operations during DARPA's Urban Disaster Response trials, navigating collapsed structures and identifying simulated survivors using onboard LiDAR and thermal imaging. The robot demonstrated dynamic replanning in GPS-denied environments and completed obstacle courses 40% faster than its nearest competitor. The system runs a custom transformer-based navigation policy trained in high-fidelity simulation.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Oversight Framework Adopted by EU AI Office
articles.summary: Anthropic published a comprehensive constitutional AI governance framework that has been formally adopted by the EU AI Office as a reference standard for high-risk AI system compliance under the AI Act. The framework includes automated red-teaming protocols, interpretability auditing requirements, and a tiered deployment gate system based on capability evaluations. This represents one of the first instances of an AI lab's internal safety methodology becoming regulatory infrastructure.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Gate-All-Around Transistors Ahead of Schedule
articles.summary: TSMC announced that its N1.4 process node using gate-all-around (GAA) nanosheet transistors has entered volume production at its Fab 20 in Hsinchu, roughly one quarter ahead of its original roadmap. The node delivers a 20% performance uplift and 30% power reduction over N2, and is expected to power next-generation AI accelerators from NVIDIA and Apple beginning mid-2027. This milestone intensifies the competition with Samsung Foundry and Intel, both of whom have faced delays on comparable nodes.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate Fault-Tolerant Logical Qubit Operations Below Error Threshold
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly demonstrated sustained fault-tolerant operations on logical qubits with error rates below the critical threshold needed for practical quantum error correction, using Quantinuum's H3 trapped-ion processor. The team executed over 10,000 consecutive logical CNOT gates with a logical error rate of 10^-7, a roughly 100x improvement over results published earlier this year. This brings commercially viable quantum computing meaningfully closer, particularly for quantum chemistry and optimization workloads.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Household Beta Program in Select U.S. Markets
articles.summary: Tesla launched a limited beta program placing Optimus Gen 3 humanoid robots in approximately 1,000 households across Texas and California for domestic assistance tasks including laundry folding, dishwashing, and basic meal preparation. The robot uses an end-to-end vision-language-action model derived from Tesla's FSD neural network stack, with over-the-air updates planned biweekly. Early reports indicate strong performance on structured tasks but continued challenges with highly deformable objects and cluttered environments.
